meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: MUST USE for planning before coding when design uncertainty remains after discovery: ambiguous scope, competing decompositions, unclear boundaries, uncertain dependency ordering, architecture decisions, a vague 'just make it good / figure out what to build' brief, or any request to plan, interview, or break work down. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode, just make it good, figure out what to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编码前制定完整的开发计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需求模糊或架构不确定，需要先规划再编码。
copy.tagline_en: Create a complete development plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to plan before coding when requirements are unclear or architecture is uncertain.

howto.what: 装上后，面对模糊或大型任务，Claude 会先进入规划模式：只读探索代码库、研究资料，只问探索无法解决的抉择，等你明确同意后，才写出一份决策完整的工作计划（含任务、验收、QA）。它绝不开始写产品代码。
howto.when: 当你说 “plan this”、“make a plan” 等规划类关键词，或提出 “just make it good” 这类模糊需求时触发。

say.text: plan this: 给登录接口加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流
say.note: 进入规划模式，探索后等你批准才写计划，不直接改代码。

say.text: make a plan: 重构用户认证模块，先调研再出方案
say.note: 先只读探索代码库，批准后才写计划。

say.text: break this down: 把“做一个好用的设置页”拆成可执行计划
say.note: 意图模糊时按最佳实践定默认值，不追问你。

howto.what_en: On a vague or large request, Claude enters planning mode: read-only codebase exploration and research, asks only forks exploration cannot resolve, waits for explicit approval, then writes one decision-complete work plan. It never implements or edits product code.
howto.when_en: Triggers on planning requests like 'plan this', 'make a plan', vague briefs like 'just make it good', or requests to interview or break work down.

say_en.text: plan this: add a 5/min per-IP rate limit to /login
say_en.note: Enters planning mode, explores, then produces a plan.

say_en.text: make a plan: refactor the auth module, research first
say_en.note: Read-only exploration; waits for approval before writing.

say_en.text: break this down: turn 'make a nice settings page' into a plan
say_en.note: Fuzzy? Best-practice defaults used; no extra questions.
